summary: Iteration 2 focused on the reported SECURITY bug (any-email login perception via stale token) and MOBILE responsiveness. Backend: 28/28 original tests + 7/7 new security tests pass (35/35 = 100%). Frontend e2e on 390x844 mobile: unregistered email stays on /login (no dashboard bounce), stale/invalid fb_token in localStorage is cleared by AuthContext on /me 401 and user is redirected to /login, admin login works, logout redirects, protected routes gated. Mobile: 0 horizontal overflow across all 10 protected pages (docW==winW==390), hamburger opens overlay sidebar showing all nav items, dashboard shows portfolio (~$99.74/$100), NFT 555 supply + 6 rares confirmed. Brute-force lockout now works (X-Forwarded-For fix from iter 1 verified).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py register throttle uses X-Forwarded-For leftmost IP correctly; behind K8s ingress this is the client IP. 5/hour cap is reasonable but a shared preview IP could false-positive real testers — consider combining with a hCaptcha/turnstile challenge before ratcheting up limits in prod.
AuthContext.jsx correctly calls clearToken() then setUser(false) on /me failure — this is exactly the fix for the reported 'any email logged in' perception. Good.
api.js Bearer interceptor + httpOnly cookies is a solid belt-and-suspenders pattern for the cross-site preview.
seed_admin is idempotent and updates password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes — matches playbook.
Register response returns access_token in body (localStorage) AND sets httpOnly cookie — consistent with login flow.
test_credentials: admin@firebird.ai / Firebird#2026 — verified working. Any new email + 6+ char password registers and returns access_token + $100 demo balance.
seed_data_creation: seed_admin + 555 NFT items with 6 legendary rares confirmed via /api/nft/stats and UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files: backend_test.py (28 tests, general regression) and test_security_iter2.py (7 tests, security-focused: unregistered-email 401, duplicate register 400, email lowercase normalization, invalid/stale token 401, response leaks). Run all with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Note: emails ending in .test TLD are rejected as reserved by pydantic EmailStr — use @nowhere.example.com. Frontend admin dashboard is at path '/' not '/dashboard'. Mobile hamburger testid is 'mobile-menu-toggle'; sidebar testid 'fixed-nav-sidebar' becomes an overlay on mobile (viewport <= 768).
rca_of_the_issue: Reported 'any email lets me in' was a stale-token perception bug: AuthContext previously kept an old user object if /me failed. Fix (verified): on /me 401, clearToken() from fb_token localStorage + setUser(false), forcing redirect to /login. Backend login already returns 401 for unknown email. Mobile fit fix (verified): html/body overflow-x hidden + tables wrapped in overflow-x-auto with min-w + rows using flex-wrap keep docW==winW==390 across all 10 protected routes.
